messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: High error rate detected for /v1/generate — 5xx spike from edge (region-us-east-1). Automatic threshold breach at 07:12 UTC. Error rate 12% over last 60s.

mike: ack -- I'm oncall. Looking at logs now. @sara can you join? seems like a networking/proxy layer issue (5xx + some 504s).

sara: joining. I see a flood of 503s from envoy on the edge gateways: 'upstream response timeout' and also 'no healthy upstream' in some traces. Pulling route configs.

devin: grabbing metrics + LB state. cpu/net ok. Noting a big traffic shift to a shard id we just rolled out yesterday. Could be a route weight misapply.

mike: product-ops — any customers reporting timeouts? triggers?

product-ops: Customer Ops flagged 2 enterprise customers with higher latency and some failed requests for background batch jobs. No major data loss, but user-facing requests are failing intermittently.

sara: Config dump from edge cluster (snippet):
```yaml
name: inference-edge
virtual_hosts:
  - name: redwood-vhost
    routes:
      - match: prefix /v1/generate
        route:
          cluster: inference-shard-5
          weight: 100
```
But cluster inference-shard-5 shows zero endpoints in SDS. That explains 'no healthy upstream'.

mike: oh. did a deploy yesterday that removed endpoints from that cluster?

devin: I see a canary rollout job that updated service tags; autoscaler spun down some nodes while healthchecks were still pending. On top of that, our envoy route weights still point 100% to that shard. Oops.

sara: immediate mitigation options: 1) update route weights to fallback cluster (inference-shard-1) 2) disable retries at envoy level to avoid retry storms 3) open circuit-breaker for the cluster to fail fast. Prefer (1) for quick customer relief.

mike: do (1) now. devin, you have access to the control plane? I'll coordinate.

devin: running: `kubectl exec -it envoy-controlplane-2 -- /usr/local/bin/envoyctl adjust-route --vhost redwood-vhost --prefix /v1/generate --set-weight inference-shard-1=100`

deploy-bot: deploy started: route-update (id: dc-8791) by devin.

sara: Monitoring: edge error rate dropping from 12% -> 3% after route change. Latency improving. Still seeing a handful of 504s from long-poll requests.

mike: product-ops, can you update the hit list? Looks like majority recovered but will monitor.

product-ops: Updating internal incident page. Impact: ~12% requests failed during window 07:05-07:18 UTC. Affected customers: ent-corp-alpha, ent-corp-beta (both on shard-5 pinned routing). Advising them: transient failures, no retries recommended.

sara: root cause hypothesis: rollout step removed endpoints from inference-shard-5 prematurely while route weights remained unchanged. This allowed traffic to hit an empty cluster. Also retries amplified apparent errors for some clients.

mike: mitigation checklist: 1) route fallback applied (done) 2) re-provision endpoints for shard-5 (in progress) 3) add deploy guard to block route weight changes until endpoints healthy 4) reduce default retry budget to avoid amplification

devin: reprovisioning nodes for shard-5 now: `asapctl scale cluster inference-shard-5 --replicas 4` — healthchecks kicked off.

lucy: i'm on call now (handoff). If you need me to take over, ping with summary.

mike: handing off -> lucy: all stable for now, keep an eye for error rate <1% for 15m before closing. Root cause = route -> empty endpoints. Followups: deploy guard + monitoring alert tweak + runbook update.

lucy: ack. I'll keep the channel warm. tagging followups into eng-runtime backlog.

sara: adding runbook note: when doing shard rollouts, ensure svc endpoints >= desired prior to adjusting route weight. Also add a pre-check to canary scripts.

product-ops: customers notified via status page update and targeted DM to ent-corp-alpha/beta. No SLA credits yet, waiting for postmortem.

mike: quick log for the incident page:
- detected: 07:12 UTC (alert)
- impact: 07:05-07:18 UTC, ~12% elevated 5xx on /v1/generate
- mitigation: route weight fallback at 07:14 UTC; node reprovision started 07:15 UTC
- owner: eng-runtime (sara), eng-sre (devin)

lucy: leaving a note to verify circuit-breaker defaults and retry logic in next sprint. Also will create a follow-up task to add a deploy guard.

sara: thanks all. I'll prepare a brief postmortem draft after we verify shard-5 fully healthy.

mike: closing oncall now, monitoring window started. If error rate creeps up, re-open. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: route-update completed: dc-8791 — success

incident-bot: Incident resolved? monitoring shows sustained error rate <1% for 5m. Marking for review.

mike: marking thread resolved; leaving channel for followups.
